newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING-Hall Kinoin files 2.5 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING-Hall Kinoin files 2.5 mln shrs.

text.p: Hall Kinoin & Associates Inc filed Tuesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for an intial public offering of up to 2.515 million shares, of which it will sell 1,666,667 shares and a group of current shareholders will sell 848,333 shares.
The San Jose, Calif.-based provider of staffing services for the information technology industry said it expects the shares to sell between $11 and $13 each.
Proceeds from the shares the company sells will be used to repay outstanding debt and to finance general corporate needs, which may include future acquisitions.
Underwriters for the offering, Montgomery Securities, Robert W. Baird & Co Inc and Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc, have an over-allotment option of up to 377,250.
After the planned sale, the company will have the equivalent of 8,933,579 shares outstanding, according to the SEC filing.
In 1996, the company reported net income of $1.4 million on net revenue of $50.6 million. That compares with net income of $682,000 on net revenue of $29.4 million reported the year earlier.
